units: energies and temperatures in D; momenta in 2*pi/a with a = in-plane metal-metal distance
dispersion_convention: eps_k = -2 t (cos kx + cos ky) - 4 t' cos kx cos ky  (Hamiltonian H0 = -t sum_<ij> - t' sum_<<ij>>); ebar_k = eps_k - (eps_min+eps_max)/2 = eps_k - 0.8

t.from: bandwidth 8t of STS panel (d) and of the Hubbard-band widths (4t) in panel (a); BCS fit of panel (c)

t_prime.from: van Hove singularity 8|t'| = 1.6 D above the band midpoint in panels (a),(c),(d); sign: saddle point lies above band centre, chemical potential at band midpoint corresponds to nu = 0.31

U.from: Hubbard-band separation 12.0 D and Mott gap U - 4t = 8.0 D in panel (a)

V_pair.from: BCS gap Delta = 1.96 D and Tc = 1.11 D at nu = 0.20 (isotropic s-wave channel, 2Delta/Tc = 3.56 reproduced); the extended-s (nearest-neighbour) channel gives 2Delta/Tc = 2.7 and is disfavoured

V_pair_effective_near_half_filling.note: effective pairing scale grows toward the Mott insulator (strong-coupling / preformed-pair regime)

derived_scales.Hubbard_band_centres: +/- 6.0 D, each band 4.0 D wide, dispersion ebar_k/2

alternatives.Hubbard-I weights: no zero at omega=0 (zero sheet at omega=+0.4 D, Luttinger count = 2)

approximations: two-pole (Hubbard-I-type) strong-coupling spectral function for the Mott insulator; BCS mean field for nu=0.2; two-branch strong-coupling pair state for nu=0.3; one-loop (bubble) spin susceptibility with (pi,pi)-peaked hyperfine form factor for NMR; Boltzmann/Arrhenius transport. k-meshes 400x400 to 1600x1600; no finite-cluster solver needed.
